using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine.Rendering;
using UnityEngine.Experimental.Rendering;
internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand
{
    const string Root = "Packages/com.vivid.render-pipelines/Editor/Tools/";
    const string Output = "Packages/VividRP/Roadmap~/Experiments/VSMCapacityCostDynamic_20260912/";
    // Generated by capacity-build-command.py from the independent literal-count oracle.
    const string ExpectedPages = "__CAPACITY_PAGES__";
    const string ExpectedSummary = "__CAPACITY_SUMMARY__";
    const string MismatchPages = "__CAPACITY_MISMATCH_PAGES__";
    const string MismatchSummary = "__CAPACITY_MISMATCH_SUMMARY__";

    public void Execute(ExecutionResult result)
    {
        var owned = new List<UnityEngine.Object>();
        var buffers = new List<GraphicsBuffer>();
        var cmd = new CommandBuffer { name = "Temporary VSM capacity fixtures" };
        var report = new StringBuilder();
        try
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Output);
            var auditAsset = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<ComputeShader>(Root + "VSMCapacityAudit.compute");
            var fixtureAsset = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<ComputeShader>(Root + "VSMCapacityFixture.compute");
            var insertionAsset = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Shader>(Root + "VSMCapacityInsertion.shader");
            if (auditAsset == null || fixtureAsset == null || insertionAsset == null)
                throw new Exception("Import the three archived capacity diagnostic shaders into Editor/Tools first.");
            var audit = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(auditAsset); owned.Add(audit);
            var fixture = UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(fixtureAsset); owned.Add(fixture);
            var material = new Material(insertionAsset); owned.Add(material);
            RenderTexture MakePool(int width, int height)
            {
                var texture = new RenderTexture(new RenderTextureDescriptor(width, height, GraphicsFormat.R32_UInt, 0)
                { enableRandomWrite = true, dimension = TextureDimension.Tex2DArray, volumeDepth = 16 });
                owned.Add(texture);
                if (!texture.Create()) throw new Exception("Cannot create fixture depth pool.");
                return texture;
            }
            GraphicsBuffer MakeBuffer(int count, int stride)
            {
                var buffer = new GraphicsBuffer(GraphicsBuffer.Target.Structured, count, stride);
                buffers.Add(buffer);
                return buffer;
            }
            var statics = MakePool(12, 8); var dynamics = MakePool(12, 8);
            var owners = MakeBuffer(6, 4); var table = MakeBuffer(8, 4); var metadata = MakeBuffer(8, 16);
            var pages = MakeBuffer(2 * 6 * 64, 4); var summary = MakeBuffer(2 * 3 * 64, 4);
            int populate = fixture.FindKernel("VSMCapacityFixture");
            int pageKernel = audit.FindKernel("VSMCapacityAuditPages");
            int reduceKernel = audit.FindKernel("VSMCapacityReduce");
            void RecordAudit()
            {
                cmd.SetComputeIntParam(audit, "_VSMPrototypePageSize", 4);
                cmd.SetComputeIntParam(audit, "_VSMPrototypePagesPerAxis", 2);
                cmd.SetComputeIntParam(audit, "_VSMPrototypePhysicalPagesPerRow", 3);
                cmd.SetComputeIntParam(audit, "_VSMPrototypePageTableEntryCount", 8);
                cmd.SetComputeIntParam(audit, "_VSMPrototypePhysicalPageCapacity", 6);
                cmd.SetComputeIntParam(audit, "_VSMProjectionCount", 2);
                cmd.SetComputeTextureParam(audit, pageKernel, "_VSMPrototypeStaticPhysicalPage", statics);
                cmd.SetComputeTextureParam(audit, pageKernel, "_VSMPrototypeDynamicPhysicalPage", dynamics);
                cmd.SetComputeBufferParam(audit, pageKernel, "_VSMPrototypePhysicalPageOwners", owners);
                cmd.SetComputeBufferParam(audit, pageKernel, "_VSMPrototypePageTable", table);
                cmd.SetComputeBufferParam(audit, pageKernel, "_VSMPrototypePageMetadata", metadata);
                cmd.SetComputeBufferParam(audit, pageKernel, "_VSMCapacityPages", pages);
                cmd.DispatchCompute(audit, pageKernel, 6, 2, 1);
                cmd.SetComputeBufferParam(audit, reduceKernel, "_VSMCapacityPages", pages);
                cmd.SetComputeBufferParam(audit, reduceKernel, "_VSMCapacitySummary", summary);
                cmd.DispatchCompute(audit, reduceKernel, 3, 2, 1);
            }
            uint[] ReadAndCheck(GraphicsBuffer buffer, string encodedExpected, string filename)
            {
                var actual = new uint[buffer.count]; buffer.GetData(actual);
                byte[] expectedBytes = Convert.FromBase64String(encodedExpected);
                var expected = new uint[expectedBytes.Length / 4]; Buffer.BlockCopy(expectedBytes, 0, expected, 0, expectedBytes.Length);
                if (actual.Length != expected.Length) throw new Exception("Fixture buffer size mismatch.");
                for (int i = 0; i < actual.Length; i++)
                    if (actual[i] != expected[i]) throw new Exception(filename + " row=" + (i / 64) + " field=" + (i % 64) + " actual=" + actual[i] + " expected=" + expected[i]);
                byte[] bytes = new byte[actual.Length * 4]; Buffer.BlockCopy(actual, 0, bytes, 0, bytes.Length);
                File.WriteAllBytes(Output + filename, bytes);
                return actual;
            }
            cmd.SetComputeTextureParam(fixture, populate, "_FixtureStatic", statics);
            cmd.SetComputeTextureParam(fixture, populate, "_FixtureDynamic", dynamics);
            cmd.SetComputeBufferParam(fixture, populate, "_FixtureOwners", owners);
            cmd.SetComputeBufferParam(fixture, populate, "_FixtureTable", table);
            cmd.SetComputeBufferParam(fixture, populate, "_FixtureMetadata", metadata);
            cmd.DispatchCompute(fixture, populate, 2, 1, 1);
            RecordAudit(); Graphics.ExecuteCommandBuffer(cmd); cmd.Clear();
            ReadAndCheck(pages, ExpectedPages, "capacity-fixture-pages.bin");
            ReadAndCheck(summary, ExpectedSummary, "capacity-fixture-summary.bin");
            report.AppendLine("Capacity audit: 12 page rows / 6 summary rows exactly match independent CPU oracle; all 64 fields checked.");
            var metadataData = new Unity.Mathematics.uint4[8]; metadata.GetData(metadataData);
            metadataData[0].y = 99; metadata.SetData(metadataData);
            RecordAudit(); Graphics.ExecuteCommandBuffer(cmd); cmd.Clear();
            ReadAndCheck(pages, MismatchPages, "capacity-fixture-mismatch-pages.bin");
            ReadAndCheck(summary, MismatchSummary, "capacity-fixture-mismatch-summary.bin");
            report.AppendLine("Metadata-owner mismatch: state 5 and excluded occupancy exactly match oracle; prior outputs overwritten.");

            var rasterStatic = MakePool(16, 16); var rasterDynamic = MakePool(16, 16);
            var rasterDepth = new RenderTexture(new RenderTextureDescriptor(16, 16, GraphicsFormat.None, 32));
            owned.Add(rasterDepth);
            if (!rasterDepth.Create()) throw new Exception("Cannot create raster depth attachment.");
            int clear = fixture.FindKernel("VSMCapacityClearLayers");
            int cases = 0;
            foreach (int distinct in new[] { 1, 8, 16, 17, 32, 64 })
            {
                for (int order = 0; order < 3; order++)
                {
                    cmd.SetComputeIntParam(fixture, "_FixtureWidth", 16); cmd.SetComputeIntParam(fixture, "_FixtureHeight", 16);
                    cmd.SetComputeTextureParam(fixture, clear, "_FixtureStatic", rasterStatic);
                    cmd.SetComputeTextureParam(fixture, clear, "_FixtureDynamic", rasterDynamic);
                    cmd.DispatchCompute(fixture, clear, 2, 2, 16);
                    foreach (var pool in new[] { rasterStatic, rasterDynamic })
                    {
                        cmd.SetRenderTarget(rasterDepth); cmd.ClearRenderTarget(true, false, Color.clear);
                        cmd.SetViewport(new Rect(0, 0, 16, 16)); cmd.SetRandomWriteTarget(0, pool);
                        cmd.SetGlobalInt("_CapacityDistinctCount", distinct); cmd.SetGlobalInt("_CapacityOrder", order);
                        cmd.DrawProcedural(Matrix4x4.identity, material, 0, MeshTopology.Triangles, 3, distinct * 64);
                        cmd.ClearRandomWriteTargets();
                    }
                    Graphics.ExecuteCommandBuffer(cmd); cmd.Clear();
                    foreach (var pool in new[] { rasterStatic, rasterDynamic })
                    {
                        var readback = AsyncGPUReadback.Request(pool); readback.WaitForCompletion();
                        if (readback.hasError) throw new Exception("Raster capacity readback failed.");
                        for (int layer = 0; layer < 16; layer++)
                        {
                            uint expected = layer < Math.Min(distinct, 16) ? Unity.Mathematics.math.asuint((distinct - layer) / 128f) : 0u;
                            var actual = readback.GetData<uint>(layer);
                            if (actual.Length != 256) throw new Exception("Unexpected raster slice dimensions.");
                            for (int pixel = 0; pixel < actual.Length; pixel++)
                                if (actual[pixel] != expected) throw new Exception("Production insertion failed: distinct=" + distinct + " order=" + order + " layer=" + layer + " pixel=" + pixel);
                        }
                        cases++;
                    }
                    report.AppendLine("Production raster distinct=" + distinct + " order=" + order + " repetitions=64 pools=2 nearest16 exact; known unique omitted/pixel=" + Math.Max(distinct - 16, 0));
                }
            }
            report.AppendLine("Raster cases=" + cases + "; full 16 layers occurs with both zero omitted (16 distinct) and nonzero omitted (17+ distinct). No real-scene overflow count is inferred.");
            report.AppendLine("PASS. Standalone GPU diagnostics; Unity Test Framework was not invoked.");
            File.WriteAllText(Output + "capacity-gpu-result.txt", report.ToString());
            result.Log(report.ToString());
        }
        catch (Exception error)
        {
            File.WriteAllText(Output + "capacity-gpu-result.txt", report.ToString() + "FAIL: " + error);
            throw;
        }
        finally
        {
            cmd.Clear(); cmd.ClearRandomWriteTargets(); Graphics.ExecuteCommandBuffer(cmd); cmd.Dispose();
            foreach (var buffer in buffers) buffer.Dispose();
            for (int i = owned.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--) UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(owned[i]);
        }
    }
}
